title: Plan mode, permissions and auto mode

folds.title: Permission modes
points: A **permission mode** decides what Claude can do without asking you first.
Press `Shift+Tab` in the terminal to cycle through the modes.
Which ones you see can vary by setup.

folds.title: Accept edits
points: Changes files and does simple file chores without asking.

folds.title: Plan mode
points: Claude reads and proposes, but does not edit your source files.
Edits stay blocked until you approve the plan.

folds.title: Plan mode at work

chat.you: Add a dark mode switch to the settings page.

chat.claude: Plan: 1. Add a switch to settings. 2. Save the choice. 3. Swap the colours. Nothing is changed yet. Approve?

folds.note: You see the plan before any file changes.

folds.title: Auto mode
points: A separate safety check reviews actions.
It blocks risky ones instead of asking you.
Fewer prompts, but not a guarantee. Skip it for sensitive work.

folds.title: Skipping all prompts
points: A mode that skips all prompts exists too.
The docs say to use it only in isolated environments, like containers or virtual machines.

folds.prompt: Which mode fits? Tap the basket.
